item.title: ABSCHWÖRZUNGE Signs With Agonia Records
item.description: ABSCHWÖRZUNGE Signs With Agonia Records The mysterious blackened death metal collective ABSCHWÖRZUNGE has signed a record deal with Agonia Records. Enigmatic in origin, the band is working on its debut studio album and follow-up to the EP “Whorl” (2024).
